scripts.text:
[Black Shadow]
Take me! You have to take responsibility for me for making eye contact!
scripts.translation:
[黑影]
帶我走吧！你跟我有了眼神接觸，必須對我負責！

scripts.text:
[Black Shadow]
If you take me, ^0000cdI'll help too^000000. I'll really help you in many ways! I'll teach you ^0000cda lot of things^000000!!
scripts.translation:
[黑影]
如果你帶我，^0000cd我也會幫忙的^000000。我會在很多方面幫你的！我會教你^0000cd很多東西^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty Notice]
^EE0000If you choose to accompany Shorty, the item ^0000cd<Help Me Shorty>^EE0000 will be automatically placed in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子的告示]
^EE0000如果你選擇與矮個子同行，物品 ^0000cd<幫我吧 矮個子>^EE0000 將自動放入你的物品欄。

scripts.text:
[Shorty Notice]
If you use the <Help Me Shorty> item in your ^EE0000inventory, you can summon Shorty and get ^0000cdhelp and advice^EE0000 from it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子的告示]
如果您使用^EE0000物品欄中的<幫我 矮個子>道具，就可以召喚矮個子，並從它那裡獲得^0000cd幫助和建議^EE0000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty Notice]
^EE0000When you reach level 31 or higher, you can receive a quest that takes you to Shorty. Completing this quest will send you away and receive a reward at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子的告示]
^EE0000當你達到31級或更高時，可以接取一個前往矮個子那裡的任務。完成該任務後，矮個子會離開，同時你會獲得獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Shorty Notice]
^EE0000Before reaching level 31, you can send Shorty away at any time via the ^0000cd<Let's Break Up>^EE0000 menu, but you will never be able to make Shorty your ally again after that.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子的告示]
^EE0000在達到31級之前，你可以通過 ^0000cd<讓我們分手>^EE0000 選單隨時讓矮個子離開，但之後你將永遠無法再讓矮個子成為你的夥伴。

scripts.text: Well, let's go together.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我們一起去吧。

scripts.text: I don't want to go together.
scripts.translation: 我不想和你一起去。

scripts.text:
[Black Shadow]
Can you do this without my help? You will surely not be able to walk ten steps and think of me. Isn't life about helping each other? It can't be like this.
scripts.translation:
[黑影]
沒有我的幫助你能做到嗎？你肯定走不了十步就會想起我。生活不就是互相幫助的嗎？不能這樣啊。

scripts.text:
[Black Shadow]
Phew- I'm glad. Are we friends now?
scripts.translation:
[黑影]
呼——太好了。我們現在是朋友了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Black Shadow]
By the way, what's with those eyes...? Are you afraid of me? I was doing this to stand out, wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[黑影]
對了，你那是什麼眼神...？你怕我嗎？我這麼做是為了引人注目，等一下...

scripts.text:
[Black Shadow]
Is this enough?
scripts.translation:
[黑影]
這樣夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
My name is Shorty!!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我叫矮個子！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text: My name is {0}.
scripts.translation: 我的名字是{0}。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
It's an easy name to say. Do you have a bag? That's the one you wear around your waist. It's just the right size for me to fit in.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
這名字很好念。你有袋子嗎？就是系在腰上的那種。剛好夠我住進去。

scripts.text: You want to go in the bag?
scripts.translation: 你想進袋子裡？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I can fit in your bag. What are you so surprised about? It won't be long. I'll be leaving soon.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我可以住進你的袋子裡。你驚訝什麼？不會很久的。我很快就會離開的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press ^0000cdALT+E^000000 to see the inside of the bag, press the consumption tab and I will be right there.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按 ^0000cdALT+E^000000 檢視袋子內部，點選消耗品標籤，我就在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
When you want to call me, press ^0000cd<Help Me Shorty>^000000 twice quickly and I'll come out of your bag and help you. How about it? Isn't it great?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
當你想叫我時，快速按兩次 ^0000cd<幫我吧 矮個子>^000000，我就會從你的袋子裡出來幫你。怎麼樣？是不是很酷？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you don't like me in the bag, take me to ^0000cdSalty^000000. That's my destination, so when the time comes, I will leave ^0000cdyour bag^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你不喜歡我在袋子裡，就把我帶到 ^0000cd鹹鹹^000000 那裡。那是我的目的地，到時候，我就會離開 ^0000cd你的袋子^000000。

scripts.text: Where is that person?
scripts.translation: 那個人在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I'll tell you later. I want to rest for now.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我稍後再告訴你。我現在想休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Good luck in the future!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
祝你未來好運！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Salty! Salty~ I'm here~ Did you wait? Did you wait a long time?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
鹹鹹！鹹鹹~ 我來了~ 你等了嗎？等了很久嗎？

scripts.text:
[In the inn]
......

[Shorty]
Salty, Salty? Salty? Where have you been Salty?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
鹹鹹，鹹鹹？鹹鹹？你去哪了鹹鹹？

scripts.text:
[Chanmo]
Who are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[禪摩]
你在跟誰說話？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I came to find Salty.. I came, but there is no Salty.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我是來找鹹鹹的... 我來了，但這裡沒有鹹鹹。

scripts.text:
[Chanmo]
Salty? Ah, you're talking about the woman who is staying in the room. I sent her on an errand.
scripts.translation:
[禪摩]
鹹鹹？啊，你說的是住在那個房間的女子。我派她去辦點事。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Errands? Why?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
辦事？為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chanmo]
I'm bored. I sent her to get some jelly and acorns.
scripts.translation:
[禪摩]
我無聊。我讓她去買些果凍和橡果。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Hey! Where are you coming from? We came to see Salty, why did you send Salty away~
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
嘿！你從哪冒出來的？我們是來看鹹鹹的，你為什麼把鹹鹹支走了~

scripts.text:
[Chanmo]
I didn't force anyone to come, and I pulled Zug's head and rolled it over. So I sent him out.
scripts.translation:
[禪摩]
我沒強迫任何人來，我揪住祖格的頭把它滾開了。所以我讓他出去了。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Then can I wait here?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那我可以在這裡等嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chanmo]
If you're in a hurry, you can help. You can find the
<NAVI>[Coco's nest]<INFO>prt_fild10,318,191,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> in the south-southwest of Prontera. You can get a bunch of acorns from Coco.
scripts.translation:
[禪摩]
如果你趕時間，可以幫忙。你可以在普隆德拉的西南偏南找到 <NAVI>[可可的巢穴]<INFO>prt_fild10,318,191,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。你可以從可可那裡得到很多橡果。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Hm.. Alright. Master, let's go too. To the Coco's nest.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
嗯.. 好的。師父，我們也去吧。去可可的巢穴。

scripts.text: Are you here?
scripts.translation: 你在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I miss Salty. Let's go see Salty.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我想念鹹鹹。我們去看鹹鹹吧。

scripts.text: Okay then.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Well then, let's go!!!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那麼，我們出發吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Chanmo]
I need to pick some acorn and jelly today.
scripts.translation:
[禪摩]
今天需要去採一些榛子和果凍。

scripts.text:
[Salty]
Alas! Acorns! Muk-muk, acorn jelly! What do you do with acorns? You eat acorn jelly~
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
哎呀！榛子！Muk-muk，榛子果凍！榛子要拿來做什麼呀？當然是吃榛子果凍啦~

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You look excited, Salty. Were you happy without me?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你看起來很興奮呢，鹹鹹。沒有我在的時候，你過得很開心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salty]
Huh? Uh-huh??? Shorty!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
誒？嗯嗯？？？矮個子！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Did you have fun without me? Did you have fun without me...
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
沒有我在的時候，你玩得開心嗎？沒有我在的時候，你玩得開心嗎...

scripts.text:
[Salty]
Shorty, why are you here? One day I received a letter saying you were leaving!!!
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
矮個子，你怎麼在這裡？有一天我收到了一封信，說你要離開了！！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
There are a number of circumstances. This situation will be explained by my master here.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
情況比較複雜。這件事由我師父在這裡解釋吧。

scripts.text:
[Salty]
What? You kidnapped our Shorty??
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
什麼？你綁架了我們的矮個子？？

scripts.text: No, that's not it...
scripts.translation: 不，不是那樣的...

scripts.text:
[Salty]
Oh yeah? But Shorty! What's going on here?
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
哦？是嗎？但是矮個子！這裡到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I went to Payon and came here because the grandmother who cooks muk said you went here.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我去了斐揚，因為那個做Muk的奶奶說你去這裡了，所以我就來了。

scripts.text:
[Salty]
Okay! I'm on the verge of going too, but let's stop at Prontera for a while and then go to Payon. Let's go pack up some stuff and travel the continent!
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
好的！我本來也要出發了，但讓我們先在普隆德拉停留一會兒，然後再去斐揚。我們去收拾點東西，然後去大陸旅行吧！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Yeah! Master, the adventures we had together were fun!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
對！師父，我們一起經歷的冒險很有趣！

scripts.text:
[Salty]
I have to say thank you. It looks like you were carrying Shorty in that little bag.
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
我得說聲謝謝。看起來你是把矮個子裝在那個袋子裡帶過來的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，非常感謝你。

scripts.text: Are you leaving?
scripts.translation: 你要走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Our relationship will not end here. Remember that you met me. Salty, is there anything else? Something to remember.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我們的關係不會就此結束。記住你遇見過我。鹹鹹，還有什麼嗎？有什麼值得紀念的東西嗎。

scripts.text:
[Salty]
Uh-huh, something like that.
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
嗯嗯，大概就是這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Is this all? Penguin? Penguin? Do you like penguins better than me?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
就這些嗎？企鵝？企鵝？你更喜歡企鵝而不是我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salty]
No, it's not... Originally I bought it in Paros to remember you, but now that I think about it, you're not a penguin, so I just kept it. Isn't it cute?
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
不，不是的... 我本來是在帕洛斯買它來紀念你的，但後來想想，你不是企鵝，所以我就一直留著它了。它不是很可愛嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Cute.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
真可愛。

scripts.text:
[Salty]
I'll give this to you. Thanks for taking care of Shorty! Shorty, let's go!
scripts.translation:
[鹹鹹]
這個給你。謝謝你照顧矮個子！矮個子，我們走吧！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, even if a lot of time passes, don't forget me and become a great adventurer who makes a name for yourself on the continent!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，即使過了很久，也不要忘記我。請成為一位在大陸上聲名遠揚的偉大冒險者吧！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Good job. If you need my help in the future, you can call me like this.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
幹得好。如果以後需要我的幫助，可以像這樣叫我。

scripts.text: How can you help me?
scripts.translation: 你能為我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
After arriving here for the first time you didn't know anything, right? I'll teach you everything I know. ^0000cdAsk me anything!^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你剛到這裡時，對什麼都一無所知，對吧？我會把我所知道的一切都教給你。^0000cd儘管問我吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
And I'll provide you with various good ^0000cdservices^000000 to help you with hunting.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
而且我會為你提供各種有用的^0000cd服務^000000，幫助你打怪。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The only thing I can do is ^0000cdincrease agility^000000 to move quickly, and ^0000cdblessing^000000 to increase strength, dexterity and intelligence, but it will definitely help, right?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我能做的只有^0000cd加速術^000000讓你移動得更快，以及^0000cd天使之賜福^000000來提升力量、敏捷和智力，但這肯定會有幫助的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Yeah! If you call me and don't say anything for a minute, I'll go back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
沒錯！如果你叫我，然後一分鐘不說話，我就會回到包裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
And when the business is over, just leave me be. I'll look around for you and go in the bag. I follow along very well.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
事情結束後，就讓我待著吧。我會四處看看，然後回到包裡。我很聽話的。

scripts.text: When are you going to find someone named Salty?
scripts.translation: 你什麼時候去找鹹鹹？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Not now, master. This Shorty, from the Galapagos knows grace. When you can take off your starter tee and start the adventure on your own, Shorty then goes away.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
現在還不是時候，師父。這隻來自加拉帕戈斯的企鵝懂得分寸。等你脫下新手T恤，能夠獨自開始冒險時，矮個子就會離開。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
At that time, even if you hold on to me and cry, I will leave you. Before that, you have to increase your level to about ^0000cdlevel 31^000000. Until then, let's do our best in the future.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
到時候，即使你緊緊抱住我哭泣，我也會離開你。在那之前，你需要把等級提升到^0000cd31級^000000左右。在那之前，讓我們共同努力吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You has grown wonderfully. So now I want to meet Salty. She'll be worried about me.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你成長得很好。所以現在我想去見見鹹鹹。她肯定很擔心我。

scripts.text: Now did you get that idea?
scripts.translation: 現在你明白那個想法了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The last letter from Salty said it was from ^0000cdPayon's inn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
鹹鹹最後那封信說，它是從^0000cd斐揚的旅店^000000寄來的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Let's go
find the <NAVI>[Inn]<INFO>payon_in01,193,23,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
讓我們去斐揚找<NAVI>[旅店]<INFO>payon_in01,193,23,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Who are you? Who are you talking to me? I don't like people I don't know talking to or touching me.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你是誰？你在跟誰說話？我不喜歡我不認識的人跟我說話或碰我。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Open the item window and you will see ^0000cdfour tabs^000000. Can you see it?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
開啟物品視窗，你會看到^0000cd四個標籤頁^000000。你能看到嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you drag and drop items that are not used frequently or should not be sold to NPCs, put them in the ^0000cd<Personal tab>, and press the trade lock button^000000 at the bottom, you will not accidentally sell these items.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你把不常用或不想賣給NPC的物品拖放到^0000cd<個人標籤頁>，並按下底部的交易鎖定按鈕^000000，你就不會不小心賣掉這些物品了。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, have you ever pressed the ^0000cdF12 key^000000? Small white squares will float around.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你按過^0000cdF12鍵^000000嗎？會有白色的小方塊漂浮出來。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Drag the skill icon or item there. If you release it, you can use skills and icons quickly and easily by simply pressing the ^0000cdshortcut button^000000. It's really convenient.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
把技能圖示或物品拖到那裡。鬆開後，只需按下^0000cd快捷鍵^000000，就能快速、輕鬆地使用技能和圖示了。真的很方便。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
He said that if you don't need the hats or clothes you got at the academy, you can exchange them for useful stuff at the ^0000cdvending machine at the job change office for each job^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
他說，如果你不需要在學院獲得的帽子或衣服，可以在^0000cd每個職業的轉職辦公室的自動售貨機^000000上兌換成有用的東西。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Salty also used it very well. I would like clams if possible.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
鹹鹹也很擅長用它。如果可以的話，我想要蛤蜊。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Let's leave after checking where the hunt was. There may be monster cards left.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
讓我們去確認一下狩獵地點後再離開吧。那裡可能還剩下魔物卡片。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
This is a valuable tip that Salty taught me~ Do you have a monster card?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
這是鹹鹹教給我的寶貴小貼士~ 你有魔物卡片嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, did you know that besides the Midgard continent known to us, you can go to new and mysterious places by boat? Mainly Al... Al... Allegro?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你知道嗎？除了我們所知的米德加爾特大陸，還可以坐船去新的神秘地方。主要是阿...阿...阿萊格羅？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdAh! You can go by boat from Alberta^000000! Let's go later! Master! It's a new adventure!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd啊！可以從艾爾貝塔坐船去^000000！我們待會兒去吧！師父！這是一次新的冒險！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I heard that there are quite a few dungeons that even a young adventurer like yourself can go too.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我聽說那裡有不少連你這樣年輕的冒險者都能去的地下城。

scripts.text: Why am I so stupid!
scripts.translation: 我為什麼這麼笨！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, what you're saying? Anyway, underground waterways, Payon's caves, ant dungeons, and shipwrecks. Don't you want to become the ruler of the dungeon, master?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你在說什麼？總之，地下水道、斐揚的洞穴、螞蟻地下城，還有沉船。師父，你不想成為地下城的主人嗎？

scripts.text: If you fight for me.
scripts.translation: 如果你為我而戰。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, you should save your body because you only have one life.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你應該保重身體，因為你只有一條命。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Is master ready? I really want to go!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，準備好了嗎？我真的很想去！

scripts.text: What is it? Where is it?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You don't know Ohiso, Boiso, Saiso, ^0000cdParamarket^000000? What would master do without me, really?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你不知道Ohiso、Boiso、Saiso、^0000cdParamarket^000000嗎？沒有我，師父你該怎麼辦啊，真是的？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Paramarket is a place that sells items that are hard to find in the market or street stalls in limited quantities and for a limited time. It is a very good place to do business.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
Paramarket是一個以限量和限時方式出售市場上或街頭攤位難以找到的物品的地方。那裡做生意非常划算。

scripts.text: How do I get there?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼去那裡？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Talk to the Paramarket Windman in ^0000cdParadise Corridor^000000 and he will send you there.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在^0000cd天堂走廊^000000和Paramarket的風人交談，他就會送你過去。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, sometimes when you want to buy something from a street vendor, you may wonder if they are selling it now and who is selling it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，有時候當你想從街頭小販那裡買東西時，你可能會想知道他們現在是否在賣，以及是誰在賣。

scripts.text: That's right. I can't even look through all the stalls.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。我連所有的攤位都看不過來。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
In that case, you can use the ^0000cdcatalog^000000. Currently, it is said that ^0000cdvending machines in Paradise or Alberta's merchant^000000 are selling it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那樣的話，你可以使用^0000cd目錄^000000。據說目前^0000cd天堂或艾爾貝塔的商人^000000有在出售。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I want to go shopping today too.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
今天我也想出去逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Do you need more help from me?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
還需要我幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Information guide
scripts.translation: 資訊嚮導

scripts.text: I'm curious about what you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我對你說的很感興趣。

scripts.text: Break up now.
scripts.translation: 現在分開吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, I'll give you the help I promised you before. Increased agility and blessing.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，我來兌現之前的承諾。提升敏捷度和天使之賜福。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
But I learned this over the shoulder, and once I do it, my soul gets tired, so I can't give it indefinitely. Although it can take me half an hour to refresh myself.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
不過我是半路學來的，用一次靈魂就會疲憊，所以不能無限使用。雖然恢復需要半小時。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you want to know when you can get it again, open the quest window with ALT+U and check the time displayed at the bottom.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你想知道何時能再次使用，請按ALT+U開啟任務視窗，檢視底部顯示的時間。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Go! Master!!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
去吧！師父！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, it hasn't even been 30 minutes yet. I'm still struggling. I'll give you more strength if you get up, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，還不到30分鐘。我還在恢復中。等你站起來我會給你更多力量，請再等等。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Go! Master!!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
去吧！師父！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
What would you like to learn about master?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你想了解什麼？

scripts.text: The path of a novice adventurer!
scripts.translation: 初心者冒險者的道路！

scripts.text: I want to help people around me.
scripts.translation: 我想幫助身邊的人。

scripts.text: I don't like the set path.
scripts.translation: 我不喜歡既定的道路。

scripts.text: There is no place I want to go.
scripts.translation: 我沒有想去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I think I saw one ^0000cd<Thinking Archer>^000000 teacher near the entrance to Izlude, but he seemed to have a lot of thoughts. Why don't you go and ask what's going on? Let's go, let's go~
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我記得在依斯魯得島入口附近有一位^0000cd<沉思的弓箭手>^000000老師，但他似乎心事重重。你不妨去問問怎麼回事？走吧，走吧~

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Why don't you meet Paul and Anne at the outside ^0000cdProntera's West Gate ^000000? As I was passing by, I heard that they needed help.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你不妨去^0000cd普隆德拉西門^000000外見見保羅和安妮。我路過時聽說他們需要幫助。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Or why not listen to the anxious middle-aged man in ^0000cdPayon^000000?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
或者去聽聽^0000cd斐揚^000000那位焦慮的中年男子怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Pressing ^0000cdCtrl+`^000000 will open the map.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按下 ^0000cdCtrl+`^000000 可以開啟地圖。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Do you see a box for selecting a region in the upper left corner?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你看到左上角有一個選擇區域的框嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
After selecting the area you want to see, check the ^0000cdmonster tab^000000 in the upper right corner or press the ^0000cdTab key^000000, you will see the name and level of the monster most distributed in that area.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
選擇你想檢視的區域後，檢視右上角的 ^0000cd魔物標籤^000000，或者按下 ^0000cdTab鍵^000000，就能看到該區域分佈最多的魔物名稱和等級。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
It would be better to go on an adventure to a place that matches the level of master. If there is ^0000cda lot of level difference with monsters^000000, you can't get 100% of the experience. You have to calculate the level difference as well, right?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
最好去和師父等級相匹配的地方冒險。如果和魔物有 ^0000cd很大的等級差距^000000，就無法獲得100%的經驗值。你也得考慮一下等級差距，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you press the town you want to go to, the navigation menu will appear. Press the ^0000cd<Guide to the target> button at the bottom^000000 and exit the map to get guidance.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選你想去的城鎮，導航選單就會出現。按下底部的 ^0000cd<前往目標>按鈕^000000，然後退出地圖即可獲得指引。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, are you bored? Then you can chat with the people around you.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你無聊了嗎？那就和周圍的人聊聊天吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Other than that, it would be okay to try ^0000cdParadise's quest^000000. Do you want to go to Paradise? They say they will give you a weapon if you go.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
除此之外，也可以試試 ^0000cd天堂任務^000000。你想去天堂嗎？聽說去了會給你一把武器。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Where do you want to go? Write ^0000cd/place^000000 in the chat window and compare your current location with the map that appears by pressing the ^0000cdCtrl+` keys^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你想去哪裡？在聊天視窗輸入 ^0000cd/地點^000000，然後按下 ^0000cdCtrl+`鍵^000000 調出地圖，對比一下你當前的位置。

scripts.text: Geffen

scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選 <NAVI>[普隆德拉]<INFO>prontera,124,76,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 即可找到。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Click on <NAVI>[Geffen]<INFO>geffen,132,66,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to find it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選 <NAVI>[吉芬]<INFO>geffen,132,66,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 即可找到。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Click on <NAVI>[Payon]<INFO>payon,177,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to find it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選 <NAVI>[斐揚]<INFO>payon,177,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 即可找到。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Click on <NAVI>[Morroc: Paradise Space Traveler]<INFO>morocc,161,97,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to find it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選 <NAVI>[夢羅克：天堂 空間旅行者]<INFO>morocc,161,97,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 即可找到。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Morroc is where Paradise is, so wouldn't it be ok to walk around?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
夢羅克是天堂所在的地方，在那裡四處逛逛也沒問題吧？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Go to <NAVI>[Morroc Paradise]<INFO>morocc,206,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
前往 <NAVI>[夢羅克 天堂]<INFO>morocc,206,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Click on <NAVI>[Alberta]<INFO>alberta,124,67,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to find it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選 <NAVI>[艾爾貝塔]<INFO>alberta,124,67,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 即可找到。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay? Then I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好的？那我先四處看看，然後再回到包裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Go and register with Lime Ivenor first, then check the bulletin board next to it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
先去萊姆·伊維諾那裡登記，然後看看旁邊的公告板。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
It would be nice to go around towns and fields to find and help people in need. Those who need help will find it easier to find with a <!> sign above their heads.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
去各個城鎮和田野轉轉，尋找並幫助需要幫助的人也不錯。需要幫助的人頭頂會有 <!> 標誌，這樣更容易找到他們。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You didn't join the Paradise Club?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你沒有加入天堂俱樂部嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Do you want to go to ^0000cdParadise^000000? They say that if you go to Paradise, they will give you weapons.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你想去^0000cd天堂^000000嗎？聽說去了那裡，他們會給你武器。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Where do you want to go? Write /place in the chat window and compare your current location with the map that appears by pressing the ^0000cdCtrl+` keys^^000000. Where is the nearest?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你想去哪裡？在聊天視窗輸入 /place，然後按 ^0000cdCtrl+` 鍵^^000000 調出地圖，對比一下你現在的位置。哪裡離得最近？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay? Then I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好的？那我先四處看看，然後再回到包裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdGo and register with Lime Ivenor first^000000, and then talk to the Boyana Ur and Paradise Logistics staff on either side.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd先去萊姆·伊維諾那裡登記^000000，然後和兩邊的博亞娜·烏爾以及天堂後勤職員談談。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
After some quests and training, they gave me equipment.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
做完幾個任務並訓練之後，他們給了我裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
What are you curious about with status and skills?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
關於狀態和技能，師父有什麼好奇的嗎？

scripts.text: I'm curious about skills.
scripts.translation: 我對技能很好奇。

scripts.text: I'm curious about statuses.
scripts.translation: 我對狀態很好奇。

scripts.text: I'm not interested anymore.
scripts.translation: 我不感興趣了。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdAlt+S keys^000000 to bring up the skill list window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按 ^0000cdAlt+S 鍵^000000 可以開啟技能列表視窗。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you check the item ^0000cd<View skill description> in the upper right corner^000000, you can view the description of the skill when you hover the mouse over the skill icon.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果勾選右上角的 ^0000cd<檢視技能說明>^000000，當滑鼠懸停在技能圖示上時，就可以檢視該技能的說明。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can learn this skill by consuming ^0000cd<Skill Points>^000000 that can be obtained whenever your job level increases. You can check the skill points you have in the lower left corner of this window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你可以消耗 ^0000cd<技能點>^000000 來學習這個技能。技能點可以在職業等級提升時獲得。你可以在這個視窗的左下角檢視你擁有的技能點。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master currently has {0} skill point {1}.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父目前有 {0} 個技能點 {1}。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Does master know about the skill tree? If master hovers the mouse over the skill they want to learn, the skills and skill levels to learn first will appear.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父知道技能樹嗎？如果將滑鼠懸停在想要學習的技能上，會顯示需要先學習的技能和等級。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
That's the skill tree. However, the skill points consumed when learning a skill are limited, so you can't learn all the skills.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
這就是技能樹。不過，學習技能消耗的技能點是有限的，所以不能學會所有技能。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
There are a total of 49 skill points that can be used for learning before master changes to a higher job. This condition is called stagnation.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在師父轉職到更高職業之前，總共有 49 個技能點可以用於學習。這種情況被稱為停滯。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdIf your job level is 40 you can change your job to a secondary job^000000, but it is recommended that you change jobs when you reach level 50.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd當職業等級達到 40 級時，你可以轉職為二轉職業^000000，但建議在達到 50 級時轉職。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Because it simplifies the transfer process. What greater reason could there be than this?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
因為這樣可以簡化轉職流程。還有什麼比這更好的理由嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Don't worry too much if you think you've raised your skills incorrectly.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你覺得自己技能點加錯了，不要太擔心。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can reset it at any time until master changes to a higher job.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在師父轉職到更高職業之前，隨時可以重置。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Go to <NAVI>[Izlude: The Hypnotist]<INFO>izlude,127,175,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for guidance.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
請前往 <NAVI>[依斯魯得島: 催眠師]<INFO>izlude,127,175,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 尋求指導。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Let's see, master...
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
讓我看看，師父...

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I heard that for Taekwon, you should raise mainly Str, Agi, and Dex. For more information,
please visit <NAVI>[Payon: Ahri]<INFO>payon,245,295,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我聽說對於跆拳職業，主要應該提升力量、敏捷和靈巧。如需更多資訊，
請前往 <NAVI>[斐揚: 阿麗]<INFO>payon,245,295,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Don't worry too much if you think you've raised your status incorrectly.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你覺得自己屬性點加錯了，不要太擔心。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can reset it at any time until master changes to a higher job.
Go to <NAVI>[Izlude: The Hypnotist]<INFO>izlude,127,175,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for guidance.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在師父轉職到更高職業之前，隨時可以重置。
請前往 <NAVI>[依斯魯得島: 催眠師]<INFO>izlude,127,175,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 尋求指導。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Call me anytime if you have any questions. I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果有任何問題，隨時叫我。我先四處看看，然後回到包裡。

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

有時候你需要靠近一點才能和某人說話。

scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選位於左上角主選單中的^0000cd任務圖示。
快捷鍵：^0000cdAlt+U^000000

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
When master receives a quest, the quest information is briefly displayed on the right side of the screen, so you can check it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
當師父接到任務時，任務資訊會簡要顯示在螢幕右側，你可以檢視。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If there is a quest you do not want to see in the list of quests, place the mouse pointer over the title and press the right mouse button to send it to the pending tab.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果任務列表中有你不想看到的任務，將滑鼠指標懸停在任務標題上，然後按滑鼠右鍵，即可將其移至待辦標籤頁。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
<Check status> - Click the ^0000cdstatus icon in the main menu located at the top left corner^000000.
Shortcut: ^0000cdAlt+A^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
<檢視狀態> - 點選位於左上角主選單中的^0000cd狀態圖示^000000。
快捷鍵：^0000cdAlt+A^000000

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
<Check skill> - Click the ^0000cdskill icon in the main menu located at the top left corner^000000.
Shortcut: ^0000cdAlt+S^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
<檢視技能> - 點選位於左上角主選單中的^0000cd技能圖示^000000。
快捷鍵：^0000cdAlt+S^000000

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Don't forget! The skill has to be activated by double clicking the icon you want to use and is casted by pressing the left mouse button once!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
別忘了！你需要雙擊想要使用的技能圖示來啟用它，然後按一次滑鼠左鍵來施放！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
<Equip and unequip equipment> - Click the ^0000cdequipment icon in the main menu located at the top left corner^000000.
Shortcut: ^0000cdAlt+Q^000000
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
<裝備與卸下裝備> - 點選位於左上角主選單中的^0000cd裝備圖示^000000。
快捷鍵：^0000cdAlt+Q^000000

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Usually, you can equip and disarm by double-clicking the left mouse button in the inventory or equipment window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
通常，你可以在物品欄或裝備視窗中雙擊滑鼠左鍵來裝備或卸下裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Arrows and bullets can only be equipped by dragging them from the inventory to the character in the equipment window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
箭矢和子彈只能通過在裝備視窗中將其從物品欄拖拽到角色身上來裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If master becomes a Merchant, you can pull a cart, which can be borrowed from the Kafra Staff in each town.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果師父成為了商人，就可以使用手推車，可以在每個城鎮的卡普拉 職員處借用。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
<Store Trade> - Click on the merchant NPC ^0000cdto trade^000000.
<User Transaction> - Right-click the player you want to trade with and select ^0000cdTrade^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
<商店交易> - 點選商人NPC^0000cd進行交易^000000。
<玩家交易> - 右鍵點選你想交易的玩家，並選擇^0000cd交易^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
<Buy and sell stalls> - Click the mouse on the stalls window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
<買賣攤位> - 用滑鼠點選攤位視窗。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
What are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你對什麼感到好奇？

scripts.text: Tip of the Day
scripts.translation: 今日小貼士

scripts.text: Command List
scripts.translation: 指令列表

scripts.text: Skills and Items Shortcut Window
scripts.translation: 技能和物品快捷視窗

scripts.text: Shortcut Key List and Registration
scripts.translation: 快捷鍵列表與註冊

scripts.text: Emotion List
scripts.translation: 表情列表

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Type ^0000cd/tip^000000 in the chat window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在聊天視窗中輸入^0000cd/tip^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
A lot of life information is contained in this. Whenever I'm bored, I read these.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
這裡包含了很多生活資訊。每當無聊的時候，我都會讀一讀。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Type ^0000cd/h^000000 in the chat window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在聊天視窗中輸入^0000cd/h^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can see the necessary information for Novice adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你可以看到初心者冒險者所需的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdF12 key^000000 to register consumption items, skills, and equipment by dragging them to the shortcut window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按^0000cdF12鍵^000000，將消耗品、技能和裝備拖拽到快捷視窗即可註冊。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Did you know that quick item use and equipment replacement are essential for effective combat?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你知道嗎，快速使用物品和更換裝備對於有效戰鬥至關重要嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdAlt+M keys^000000 to register frequently used shortcut commands~
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按^0000cdAlt+M鍵^000000可以註冊常用的快捷指令~

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I use this function to register frequently used commands.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我用這個功能來註冊常用的指令。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdAlt+Y keys^000000 to check the command list and turn it ON/OFF.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按^0000cdAlt+Y鍵^000000可以檢視指令列表，並開啟或關閉它。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can check and turn on/off various options by master's choice.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
您可以檢視並開啟/關閉由師父選擇的各種選項。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdAlt+L keys^000000 to view and use the list of emotions and shortcut commands.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按^0000cdAlt+L鍵^000000可以檢視並使用表情和快捷指令列表。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, do you know that conversation isn't just about words? Appropriate use of emotion makes the conversation richer.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，你知道嗎，對話不僅僅是關於語言？恰當地使用表情可以讓對話更豐富。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Yes. Call me again if you need me.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
是的。如果您需要我，請再次呼喚我。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master doesn't want to succeed? Salty says she's training hard because she wants to succeed.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父不想成功嗎？鹹鹹說她努力訓練是因為她想成功。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The tradition is ^0000cdbeing born again in Valhalla and returning to Novice^000000. But it's not a normal Novice, it's called a High Novice.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
傳統是^0000cd在瓦爾哈拉重生並回到初心者^000000。但這不是普通的初心者，被稱為高等初心者。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
In other words, it's evolution. People who have passed down say that there are many advantages to getting the job of the past again.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
換句話說，這是進化。傳說再次獲得過去的職業有很多優勢。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
There are many statuses, and above all, if you have a secondary job, you can increase your ^0000cdjob level to 70^000000. You will be able to use more skills.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
有很多狀態，最重要的是，如果你有第二職業，你可以將^0000cd職業等級提升到70^000000。你將能夠使用更多的技能。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you want to succeed, find a person named
<NAVI>[Metheus Sylph]<INFO>yuno_in02,88,164,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> ^0000cdat Sage Academy in Yuno^000000, and he will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你想成功，找到位於<NAVI>[Metheus Sylph]<INFO>yuno_in02,88,164,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> ^0000cd尤諾賢者學院^000000的人，他會指導你。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you're not interested in transcending, you can just change jobs. But he said that it's better to pass it on when you think about the future.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你不感興趣超越，你可以只是改變職業。但他說，考慮到未來，傳承更好。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you are not interested in changing jobs or transcending...
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你不感興趣改變職業或超越...

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The continent is full of festivals all year round. How about participating in the festival when master is also free?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
大陸全年都有節日。當師父也有空時，參加節日怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Now...
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
現在...

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I heard that there will be a winter hunting contest hosted by the royal family at the royal palace! I want to do a hunting contest! I want to do it! Fight monsters!!! Let's go to Prontera!!!!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我聽說王室將在王宮舉辦冬季狩獵比賽！我想參加狩獵比賽！我想參加！打魔物！！！讓我們去普隆德拉！！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I'll definitely take you with me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我一定會帶你一起去，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Master, I'll tell you the basics, but literally just the basics.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
師父，我會告訴你基礎知識，但只是最基礎的知識。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdMidgard Continent^000000 is said to have the greatest influence of the three kingdoms of Arunafelts, Schwaldzwald, and Rune-Midgarts. Each continent has an airship you can readily use.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd米德加爾特大陸^000000據說受阿魯納費爾茲、施瓦茨瓦爾德和盧恩·米德加茲三大王國影響最大。每個大陸都有可以隨意使用的飛空艇。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdRune-Midgarts^000000. A kingdom ruled by seven royal families and the power of magic prevails.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd盧恩·米德加茲^000000。由七大貴族家族統治的王國，魔法力量盛行。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The capital is Prontera, the satellite city of Izlude, Geffen where wizards gather, Payon to the east, Alberta where you can go travel to different regions, Aldebaran with the clock tower, and Morroc.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
首都是普隆德拉，衛星城市有依斯魯得島、巫師聚集的吉芬、東邊的斐揚、可以前往不同地區旅行的艾爾貝塔、擁有鐘樓的阿爾戴巴蘭，以及夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
We met at Izlude in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Remember? Also Payon with Salty, and Paros from where I left. They're all in Rune-Midgats.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我們在盧恩·米德加茲王國的依斯魯得島相遇了，記得嗎？還有鹹鹹所在的斐揚，以及我離開的帕洛斯。它們都在盧恩·米德加茲。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdArunafelz^000000. This is a church that worships a goddess. So, there is a Pope. Of course, you can't meet anyone, but is it possible? Maybe we can meet at least once.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd阿魯納費爾茲^000000。這是一個崇拜女神的教會。所以那裡有教皇。當然，你見不到任何人，但有可能嗎？也許我們至少能見面一次。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Arunafelz has a temple capital, Rachel, and a canyon town, Veins.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
阿魯納費爾茲有聖都拉赫，以及峽谷城鎮伯仁斯。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdSchwaldzwald^000000 Republic. As the name suggests, there is a president. The capital city, Yuno, is floating in the air, so it's worth a visit. It must be spectacular.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd施瓦茨瓦爾德^000000共和國。顧名思義，那裡有總統。首都尤諾漂浮在空中，值得一遊。那一定很壯觀。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
And there is Lighthalzen, where the headquarters of Rekenberg is located, there is the mining town of Einbroch, the mines of Einbech, and there is also the rural village of Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
還有裡希塔樂鎮，那裡是雷肯貝格的總部所在地，有礦業城鎮艾音布羅克，艾音貝赫的礦山，以及鄉村村莊毀葛。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
There are other Utan villages such as Umbala, or Niflheim, the land of the dead. It's a place I've always wanted to visit!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
還有汶巴拉這樣的烏坦村莊，或者亡者之地尼弗海姆。那是我一直想去的地方！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Many people thought that there was only the continent of Midgard on this land, but one day, people appeared in the form of ^0000cdcats^000000. No one knew where they came from.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
很多人以為這片土地上只有米德加爾特大陸，但有一天，以^0000cd貓^000000形態出現的人出現了。沒人知道他們是從哪裡來的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
These people, called Doram, are from a place far across the sea, the ^0000cdFar-Star Continent^000000. They said that the road was opened for them only recently.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
這些被稱為多蘭的人，來自遙遠的海外，^0000cd遠星大陸^000000。他們說，通往那裡的道路最近才剛剛開通。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
In the Far-Star Continent, the port city ^0000cdLasagna^000000 is the most famous. I want to go there too.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在遠星大陸，港口城市^0000cd羅札納^000000最為著名。我也想去那裡看看。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
To get here, take the boat from Malangdo or Izlude. Do you remember where we got off?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
要來這裡，可以從馬拉貢多或依斯魯得島乘船。你還記得我們是在哪裡下船的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You've seen people in the form of cats, called Dorams, who come and go. They haven't had their first contact with this Midgard continent, but now they have taken root and established themselves everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你見過那些被稱為多蘭的貓形態的人來來去去。他們並不是第一次接觸米德加爾特大陸，但現在他們已經在這裡紮下了根，遍佈各地。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
It turns out that while sailing in a faraway place called the Far-Star continent, they met a storm and fell to a place called Malangdo. Literally, the ship fell from the sky.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
原來他們在前往遠星大陸的遙遠航程中遇到了風暴，船隻墜落到了馬拉貢多。字面意思上，船是從天上掉下來的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Dorams have a lot of magical talents, so if you go to ^0000cdMalangdo^000000 you will have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
多蘭人擁有很多魔法天賦，所以如果你去^0000cd馬拉貢多^000000，一定會玩得很開心。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdYou can take the boat^000000 from Izlude. If you have Canned Malangdo that can be obtained in a special way, you can use it to travel to there.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd你可以從依斯魯得島乘船^000000。如果你擁有通過特殊方式獲得的“馬拉貢多罐頭”，就可以用它前往那裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you want to feel the atmosphere of a foreign country, you should go to that ^0000cdlocal region^000000. ^0000cdIf you go to Alberta's dock^000000, you can meet the sailors who send people to each local region.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你想感受異國風情，應該去那個^0000cd當地地區^000000。^0000cd如果你去艾爾貝塔的碼頭^000000，就能遇到那些將人們送往各個當地地區的水手。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Amatsu, Kunlun, Moscovia, Brasilis, Ayothaya, Dewata, Port Malaya, Rock Ridge, etc. The unknown world is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
櫻花城、崑崙、莫斯科比亞、巴西、哎喲泰雅、德瓦他、馬來港、洛克理奇等等。未知的世界在等著你。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Doesn't it make your heart flutter just by hearing the words? See you later, master.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
光是聽到這些名字，難道不會讓你心潮澎湃嗎？回頭見，師父。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Uh, I know, here. If you go through the eastern part of Morroc or talk to Agent Catson in Paradise, they'll send you there.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
呃，我知道，在這裡。如果你穿過夢羅克的東部，或者在天堂與特工凱森交談，他們就會把你送過去。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can meet people you've never seen before.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你可以見到從未見過的人。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
From the base of the Expeditionary Forces of the Three Kingdoms, you can go to Splendid, Eclage, Manuk or El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
從三國遠征軍的基地，你可以前往斯普林德、埃克拉珠、馬努克或埃爾迪卡特斯。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay? Then I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好的？那我先四處看看，然後再回到包裡。

[Shorty]
What quest are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你對哪個任務感興趣？

^0000cdWhy don't you meet Paul and Anne at^000000 the outside Prontera's West Gate? As I was passing by, I heard that they needed help.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd你不妨去普隆德拉西門外見見保羅和安妮^000000？我路過時聽說他們需要幫助。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Or why not listen to the anxious middle-aged man from ^0000cdPayon^000000?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
或者，你不妨聽聽來自^0000cd斐揚^000000的那位焦慮的中年男子怎麼說？

你將能瞭解這個世界的流程，並知曉正在發生的重大事件。

scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
大陸全年都有節日。當師父也有空時，參加節日怎麼樣？

[Shorty]
I heard that there will be a winter hunting contest hosted by the royal family at the royal palace! want to do a hunting contest! I want to do it! Fight monsters!!! Let's go to Prontera!!!!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我聽說王室將在王宮舉辦冬季狩獵大賽！我想參加狩獵大賽！我想參加！打魔物！！！我們去普隆德拉吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I'll definitely take you with me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我一定會帶你一起去，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdHave you been to Paradise^000000?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd你去過天堂嗎^000000？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
There are many quests waiting for master. Besides, they also provide equipment for beginners.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那裡有很多工等待師父完成。此外，他們還為新手提供裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Of course, it's not free, but you have to solve a simple quest from Paradise. Besides, they also rent out shadow equipment.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
當然，這不是免費的，你需要完成天堂的一個簡單任務。此外，他們還出租暗影裝備。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you have any questions, go to the Paradise Office.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果有任何問題，請前往天堂辦事處。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay? Then I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好的？那我先四處看看，然後再回到包裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I wonder where..
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
不知道在哪裡...

scripts.text: Field Hunting Guide
scripts.translation: 野外狩獵指南

scripts.text: Dungeon Guide
scripts.translation: 地下城指南

scripts.text: Other Dungeon Guide
scripts.translation: 其他地下城指南

scripts.text: Enough
scripts.translation: 夠了

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdCtrl+` keys^000000 to open a map.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按下 ^0000cdCtrl+` 鍵^000000 開啟地圖。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Do you see a box for selecting an area at the top left? After selecting the area you want to see, check the ^0000cdmonster tab^000000 in the upper right corner or press the ^0000cdTab key^000000, you will see the name and level of the monster most distributed in that area.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你看到左上角有一個選擇區域的框嗎？選擇你想檢視的區域後，檢查右上角的 ^0000cd魔物標籤^000000 或按下 ^0000cdTab 鍵^000000，你將看到該區域分佈最多的魔物名稱和等級。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
It would be better to go on an adventure to a place that matches the level of master. ^0000cdIf there is a lot of level difference with monsters, you can't get 100% of the experience^000000. You have to calculate the level difference as well, right?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
最好去與師父等級相匹配的地方冒險。^0000cd如果與魔物的等級差距過大，你將無法獲得100%的經驗值^000000。你也需要計算等級差距，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you press the town you want to go to, the navigation menu will appear. Press the ^0000cd<Guide to the target> button at the bottom^000000 and exit the map to get guidance.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選你想去的城鎮，導航選單就會出現。按下底部的 ^0000cd<前往目標>按鈕^000000，然後退出地圖即可獲得指引。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Press the ^0000cdCtrl+` keys^000000 to open a map.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
按下 ^0000cdCtrl+` 鍵^000000 開啟地圖。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdDo you see a box where you can select an area^000000 in the upper left? If you select an area you want to check out then you will see it marked with a red box the map with ^0000cdthe name of the main dungeon^000000 written on it.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd你看到左上角有一個選擇區域的框嗎^000000？如果你選擇想要檢視的區域，地圖上會用紅框標記出 ^0000cd主要地下城的名稱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Then check the ^0000cdmonster tab in the upper right corner or press the Tab key^000000 to display the level of the dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
然後檢查右上角的 ^0000cd魔物標籤或按下Tab鍵^000000 以顯示地下城的等級。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Sometimes, some dungeons can only be entered through special quests, so you need to gather information as well, alright?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
有時，某些地下城只能通過特殊任務進入，所以你也需要注意收集相關資訊，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Why don't you try the underground waterway first? The Swordsman Guild is always recruiting, but I heard it's good for beginner adventurers to gain experience.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你不妨先試試地下水道？劍士公會一直在招募，但我聽說這對新手冒險者獲取經驗很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
There are a lot of memorial dungeons, nightmare dungeons, illusion dungeons...etc.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
有很多記憶地下城、夢魘地下城、幻覺地下城...等等。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdMemorial Dungeon^000000
In addition to the regular dungeons, there are also special dungeons. Usually, they say that it is a special place created by an unknown power in this world.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd記憶地下城^000000
除了普通地下城外，還有特殊地下城。據說它們是由這個世界中某種未知力量創造的特殊場所。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
A lot of experienced adventurers usually go, but they say there are a few low-level places that can be reached with a little training. Either in Orc Village or Rachel...
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
很多經驗豐富的冒險者都會去，但據說也有一些低等級的地方，稍微訓練一下就能到達。比如在獸人村或拉赫...

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
It is said to be located in villages and general fields, and there are many places called Dimensional Rifts.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
據說它們位於村莊和一般野外，有很多被稱為次元裂縫的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdNightmare Dungeon^000000
It is said that it is a dungeon that is much more difficult of a challenge than a normal dungeon. Even the monsters are not like the monsters we know of. When you find the dungeon, if someone suspicious tells you that it will send you to a more difficult place, try it out.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd夢魘地下城^000000
據說這是一種比普通地下城更具挑戰性的地下城。裡面的魔物也不同於我們熟知的魔物。當你找到地下城時，如果有人可疑地告訴你它會把你送到更困難的地方，不妨試一試。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdIllusion Dungeon^000000
No one knows what kind of dungeon these dungeons are. I guess it's something like a dream or a fantasy. There is a special stone that only comes from here, and everyone says that they aim for the stone and fight for it. They say that the stone can be exchanged for powerful weapons.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd幻覺地下城^000000
沒人知道這些地下城到底是什麼樣的。我想它們就像夢境或幻想一樣。這裡有一種特殊的石頭，只有這裡才會產出，大家都為了爭奪這種石頭而戰。據說這種石頭可以兌換成強大的武器。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay? Then I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好的？那我先四處看看，然後再回到包裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
So, what basic info do you want to know?
Refer to <URL>[guide]<INFO>http://ro.gnjoy.com/guide/systeminfo/,1024,768</INFO></URL> for the Basic.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那麼，你想了解哪些基礎資訊？
請參考 <URL>[嚮導]<INFO>http://ro.gnjoy.com/guide/systeminfo/,1024,768</INFO></URL> 獲取基礎資訊。

scripts.text: Party
scripts.translation: 隊伍

scripts.text: Guilds and Clans
scripts.translation: 公會與氏族

scripts.text: Smelt
scripts.translation: 精煉

scripts.text: Enchant
scripts.translation: 強化

scripts.text: Family
scripts.translation: 家族

scripts.text: Chat
scripts.translation: 聊天

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Sometimes you would like to be with your friends, if they fight in dungeons, enjoy adventures together, or sometimes just sit and chat.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
有時候你會想和朋友們在一起，一起在地下城戰鬥，一起享受冒險的樂趣，或者只是坐在一起聊天。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
In that case, make a party and do it together.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
在這種情況下，組建一個隊伍一起行動吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The party window can be easily opened and with the ^0000cdAlt+Z keys^000000. When evenly distributing experience for hunting, the difference of ^0000cdlevel between party members^000000 can be equal to or less than 15.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
隊伍視窗可以輕鬆開啟，使用 ^0000cdAlt+Z 鍵^000000。在平均分配打怪經驗時，^0000cd隊伍成員之間的等級差^000000 必須小於或等於15級。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you click the circle on the left in the chat window at the bottom, you can designate a chat partner, and you can send a message only to party members there, so it's useful.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
點選底部聊天視窗左側的圓圈，可以指定聊天物件，並只向隊伍成員傳送訊息，這非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Sometimes you will want to belong somewhere and feel a bond with someone. In that case, you just need to belong to a ^0000cdguild or clan^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
有時候你會想歸屬於某個地方，並與某人建立聯絡。在這種情況下，你只需要加入一個 ^0000cd公會或氏族^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The biggest characteristic of a guild is a battle over a hideout. It is also called a siege.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
公會最大的特點是爭奪據點。這也稱為攻城戰。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can enter a guild that has already been formed by invitation, or you can buy Empelium sold at the office to create a guild.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你可以通過邀請加入已經成立的公會，或者購買辦事處出售的Empelium來建立公會。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
In addition to the sense of belonging, the guild can enjoy various benefits such as the guild's own skills and dedicated warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
除了歸屬感外，公會還可以享受各種福利，如公會專屬技能和專用倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
For details
refer to <URL>[Guild Guide]<INFO>http://ro.gnjoy.com/guide/systeminfo/systemGuild1.asp,1024,768</INFO></URL>
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
詳情請參閱
<URL>[公會指南]<INFO>http://ro.gnjoy.com/guide/systeminfo/systemGuild1.asp,1024,768</INFO></URL>

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If joining a guild is burdensome, then a ^0000cdclan^000000 would be good. It may be difficult to feel as close to others like in a guild, but the clan also has various benefits.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果覺得加入公會負擔太重，^0000cd氏族^000000也是不錯的選擇。雖然可能不像公會那樣容易與他人建立親密感，但氏族也有各種福利。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdThe building in the lower left corner of Prontera Central Fountain^000000 is the Clan Headquarters, so take a look.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd普隆德拉中央噴泉左下角的建築^000000是氏族總部，不妨去看看。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Do you want to make the equipment you have stronger? In that case, you can find the ^0000cdsmelter^000000 in each town.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你想讓你擁有的裝備變得更強嗎？如果是這樣，你可以在每個城鎮找到^0000cd鐵匠^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Smelting requires special items and zeny. It depends on the type and level of the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
強化需要特殊物品和Zeny。具體取決於裝備的型別和等級。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
One thing to be aware of is that there is a safe refinement level in smelting, and if you proceed with refining above a certain level, the equipment has a chance to be destroyed. You must have good luck.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
需要注意的是，強化有一個安全等級，如果超過一定等級繼續強化，裝備有機率被破壞。這需要你有很好的運氣。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Oh, besides the smelter in each town, I heard that the^0000cd<Item Mall>^000000 offers a higher success chance of smelting.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
哦，除了每個城鎮的鐵匠，我聽說^0000cd<物品商城>^000000提供更高的強化成功率。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you are curious, go to ^0000cd<cash sales guide>^000000 in each town. They will guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你感興趣，可以去每個城鎮的^0000cd<現金銷售指南>^000000。他們會指引你前往。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you want to make your equipment stronger or give it a special ability, why not try to ^0000cdenchant^000000 it?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你想讓裝備更強或賦予其特殊能力，為什麼不試試^0000cd附魔^000000呢？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cd<Malangdo>, <Item Mall>^000000, or ^0000cd<Seyablem> and <Leyablem>^000000 which can be found in major towns, are mainly doing this.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd<馬拉格多>、<物品商城>^000000，或者主要城鎮中可找到的^0000cd<塞亞布勒姆>和<雷亞布勒姆>^000000，主要提供這項服務。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Equipment obtained from a specific dungeon or a specific area can only be ^0000cdenchanted^000000 from in that area.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
從特定地下城或特定區域獲得的裝備，只能在該區域內進行^0000cd附魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
However, not all equipment can be enchanted, so you should check the conditions carefully.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
不過，並非所有裝備都可以附魔，所以你應該仔細檢查條件。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Are you sure you want to be with another person for the rest of your life? Then you can start a ^0000cdfamily^000000.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你確定想和另一個人共度餘生嗎？那麼你可以組建一個^0000cd家庭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
^0000cdYou can marry the person you like^000000, or you can adopt a ^0000cdchild^000000. It is also possible for you to be adopted as the child of another couple.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
^0000cd你可以和你喜歡的人結婚^000000，或者收養一個^0000cd孩子^000000。你也可以被另一對夫婦收養為他們的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
They say that you can gain special marriage skills to use as a family.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
據說你可以獲得特殊的婚姻技能，供家庭使用。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you are interested in getting married, go to the Church of Prontera or the Wedding Hall of Lasagna. You will need some supplies before you can marry. The Church of Prontera can only marry humans.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你對結婚感興趣，可以去普隆德拉的教堂或羅札納的婚禮大廳。結婚前你需要準備一些用品。普隆德拉的教堂只能為人類舉行婚禮。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Adoption requires a wedded couple's level to be 70 or higher and the child to be adopted is a Novice or a first class.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
收養要求已婚夫婦的等級達到70級或以上，且被收養的孩子必須是初心者或一轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The Family Division of the Prontera District Office says that you can purchase items necessary for a wedding or check with family-related matters, so if you need it, go check it out.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
普隆德拉區辦公室的家庭部門表示，你可以購買婚禮所需的物品或諮詢家庭相關事務，如果有需要，不妨去看看。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can refer to
<URL>[Family]<INFO>http://ro.gnjoy.com/guide/systeminfo/systemLovers1.asp,1024,768</INFO></URL> for more details.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你可以參閱
<URL>[家庭]<INFO>http://ro.gnjoy.com/guide/systeminfo/systemLovers1.asp,1024,768</INFO></URL> 瞭解更多詳情。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Can you see the message window at the bottom? You can chat with other people by entering your message there or you can also send other message types there as well.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你能看到底部的訊息視窗嗎？你可以在那裡輸入訊息與其他人聊天，也可以傳送其他型別的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
If you want to chat with a small number of people who are neither party nor guild members, you can open a chat window.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
如果你想和少數既不在隊伍也不在公會的人聊天，可以開啟一個聊天視窗。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
You can simply open the chat window with the ^0000cdAlt+C keys^000000. You can also set the maximum number of participants and and a password.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你可以直接按 ^0000cdAlt+C^000000 開啟聊天視窗。你還可以設定最大參與人數和密碼。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay? Then I'll look around a bit and get back into the bag.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好的？那我先四處看看，然後再回到包裡。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Aww!!! I'm Shorty! What's my master's name?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
哇！！！我是矮個子！請問師父的名字叫什麼？

scripts.text: Master?
scripts.translation: 師父？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
The first person you meet should be called Master.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
你遇到的第一個人應該被稱為師父。

scripts.text: Are you talking about a teacher?
scripts.translation: 你是在說老師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Yeah. That's it. I'm Galapago Shorty, I'm a good talker.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
對，就是這樣。我是啤酒企鵝矮個子，我很會說話的。

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Salty! Salty is my friend. I'm here to meet Salty. So you must take me to Salty.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
鹹鹹！鹹鹹是我的朋友。我來這裡是為了見鹹鹹。所以你必須帶我去找鹹鹹。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Well then, let's go!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那麼，我們走吧！

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
What...? Master...? What? Let's break up? Here? Now? Are you serious?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
什...？師父...？什麼？我們要分手嗎？就在這裡？現在？你是認真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Is there anything you didn't like? Was I not quiet in my bag? Oh, that's what you didn't like, yes... Then there's nothing I can do.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
有什麼你不喜歡的嗎？是我在袋子裡不夠安靜嗎？哦，原來你不喜歡這個，是的...那我無能為力了。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Then you won't take me to ^0000cdSalty^000000? Salty will be grateful of you for taking me there. I'll pay thanks because Salty knows grace.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那麼你不帶我去找 ^0000cd鹹鹹^000000 了嗎？鹹鹹會感謝你的。我會表達感謝，因為鹹鹹懂得感恩。

scripts.text: Let's go our separate ways.
scripts.translation: 我們分道揚鑣吧。

scripts.text: Let's go together until then.
scripts.translation: 在那之前我們繼續同行吧。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Okay. Well said, master. Even if I get stuck in the bag, I'll get out of it quickly.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
好吧。說得好，師父。即使我被困在袋子裡，我也會很快出來的。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Let's help each other a little bit more. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
讓我們再互相幫助一下吧。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Yes. Master has a stone cold heart. Then there is nothing that can be done. I think our relationship ends here.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
是的。師父有一顆冷酷之心。那麼就沒有什麼可做的了。我想我們的關係到此為止了。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
I don't know how it was with you, but I enjoyed our time together.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
我不知道對你來說如何，但我享受我們在一起的時光。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Stay healthy and I bid you well. I hope master will not forget that Galapago was there.
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
保重身體，祝你一切順利。希望師父不會忘記啤酒企鵝曾經存在過。

scripts.text:
[Shorty]
Well then, master, goodbye. Goodbye!
scripts.translation:
[矮個子]
那麼，師父，再見。再見！
